Working alternative to Instant Building Repair?
Hello.  Per the title, I have been searching for an alternative to aedenthorn's Instant Building Repair.  I was using [this version by Pineapple](https://thunderstore.io/c/valheim/p/Pineapple/InstantBuildingRepair/), and sadly found it was rendering the command console unusable.  This mod has been *indispensable* for me and my players, though, so I was hoping someone here might know a viable alternative.  No version of this mod I have seen online is fully usable.

Thank you for your time\~
